<thought>We need the number of aromatic carbons in the unknown molecule. The only way to infer that is to obtain its 13C NMR spectrum and count the signals that fall in the typical aromatic carbon chemical shift range (≈110–160 ppm). This requires measuring the carbon NMR, which is the only tool that can provide the needed information. We'll request the carbon NMR spectrum and then count the aromatic-region peaks.</thought>
